entry.author: NZ Defence Force
entry.summary:
Maritime Explosive Ordinance Disposal (EOD) divers from HMNZS Matataua, the Royal New Zealand Navy's littoral warfare unit, are in Hawaii for Exercise RIMPAC.

The Officer in Charge explains what type of tasks the team will be conducting at the world's largest international maritime warfare exercise. A great opportunity to work with partners and share training insights and the latest operational techniques.
